question: In the 2020 - 21 season, each NBA team played ______ regular-season games.
solution:
The correct answer is **__72.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the 2020 - 21 season, each NBA team played 72 regular-season games.**
 
• The 2020–21 NBA season was the 75th season of the National Basketball Association (NBA), though the 75th anniversary was not celebrated until the following season.
 
• Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the regular season was reduced to **72 games** for each team and began on December 22, 2020.
 
• The season started just 72 days after the completion of the 2020 NBA Finals, the shortest off-season in league history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Basketball Association (NBA):**

 
 
• It was established on **June 6, 1946, in Newyork, USA.**
 
• NBA is composed of **30 teams **and is a professional Basketball league.
 
• It has been recognized by the International Basketball Federation.
 
• **Adam Silver** is the current Chief Executive Officer who succeeded David Stern.
 
 
 
• **The Los Angeles Lakers** are NBA champions, defeating the** Miami Heat 106-93 in Game 6 of the NBA Finals on 11 Oct 2020.**
 
• This was the Lakers' first NBA Finals appearance since 2010 when the late** Kobe Bryant won his fifth **and final NBA title.
 
• It's the fourth championship for **LeBron James, in his 10th NBA Finals.**
 
• He became the NBA's all-time leader in playoff games played, at **260.**
